On Thursday, April 24, 2014 9:58 AM, David Hall <e            wrote:


 Cecile: I hope you are having a positive day. I had a very good conversation with Jeffrey yesterday. He
 asked me to share with him the preliminary budget for the medical school. I have attached it to this
 email. Please share with him the following points.
          1.     The budget is not intended to be the final budget for the medical school but is
          illustrative of what we anticipate to be the revenue and expenditures for its operation.
           2.    Our conversation focused on the revenue side and the need for us to secure gift
           agreements totalling $8.5 million before we submit our documents to the accreditors, which
           would be in the next few months. We will also need close to another $2,000 to supplement
           the cost of the Simulation Center.
           3.    I ask that these materials be held confidentially since they have not been shared with
           anyone outside of our Board members.
          4.
 If he has any questions I would be glad to discuss the budget with him or any other aspect of the
 medical school project.

 Thanks for your valuable assistance.

 David
